parsed.why: No trans criminalisation or documented visitor restriction; but no gender-identity protections and hate-crime enforcement gaps, with court-forced reinvestigations, mixed social acceptance, thin trans record.

Strong equal-treatment protections in services/healthcare, yet documented mob attack, discontinued police-mistreatment complaints, male-default custody with only petition transfer; social fear remains high.
Active criminalisation applied to gender nonconformity: convictions, men's prison, corporal law, police raids, extortion, forced exams, official hostility, no protections; severe if outed.
No criminalisation, but organised hostility: police torture probe unresolved, repeated unpunished centre attacks, current LGBT violence, weak hate-crime enforcement; protections unreliable.

Current anti-discrimination, facility access and hate-crime law protect visitors; active rollback bills, ombudsman review, and pending first reading reduce safety but do not yet create enforceable exposure.
